title: LatAm Synth — Input
description: Parameters for generating synthetic LatAm financial savings behavior data.

users.title: Number of users
users.description: How many synthetic users to generate. Each user gets 0–N saving goals and transactions.

seed.title: Random seed
seed.description: Integer seed for full reproducibility. Leave empty for a random run.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: Restrict output to specific countries. Leave empty to use the calibrated LatAm mix (Mexico 46.6%, Colombia 14.4%, Argentina 9.1%, …). Valid values: Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, USA, Spain, Peru, Chile, Ecuador, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica, Panama, Uruguay.

format.title: Output format
format.description: File format for the output stored in the key-value store.

push_to_dataset.title: Push transactions to Dataset
push_to_dataset.description: When enabled (default), all generated transactions are pushed to the run's default Dataset so you can export them as JSON/CSV/Excel from the Dataset tab or connect Apify integrations. Disable for very large runs (>10K users) if you only need the CSV files from the Key-value store.
